protocol: Fixed trials, all outcomes retained; rate-limit failures separately preserved with unknown totals.

comparisons.label: Claude Opus 5.5
comparisons.description: 3 full paired trials, each with three synthetic tasks and twelve changing-context stages. Both arms use Claude Opus 5.5, identical goals, checks, archive tools and per-call limits. SDK reference receives full history; Offload selects context and can recover the originals.
comparisons.limitation: Development fixtures, not independent unseen tasks or a broad reasoning benchmark. Exact JSON checks cover facts and required format. All-in Offload cost remains unknown because selector prices are absent. Request scheduling waits count in arm latency. Provider routing and caching are uncontrolled.
